    round_targets = case["round_targets"]
    forced = case["forced"]
    # Validate types
    if not isinstance(round_scores, list) or not all(isinstance(r, list) for r in round_scores):
        raise ValueError("round_scores must be list of lists")
    if not isinstance(round_targets, list) or not all(isinstance(t, int) for t in round_targets):
        raise ValueError("round_targets must be list of ints")
    if not isinstance(forced, list) or not all(isinstance(f, int) for f in forced):
        raise ValueError("forced must be list of ints")
    # Check lengths
    if len(round_scores) == 0:
        raise ValueError("round_scores empty")
    n = len(round_scores[0])
    for i, r in enumerate(round_scores):
        if len(r) != n:
            raise ValueError(f"round_scores[{i}] length mismatch")
    if len(round_targets) != len(round_scores):
        raise ValueError("round_targets length must equal number of rounds")
    # Validate forced indices
    forced_set = set()
    for f in forced:
        if f < 0 or f >= n:
            raise ValueError(f"Forced index {f} out of range")
        if f in forced_set:
            raise ValueError(f"Duplicate forced index {f}")
        forced_set.add(f)
    # Initialize active set
    active = set(range(n))
    history = []
    for i in range(len(round_scores)):
        target = round_targets[i]
        if target < 0:
            raise ValueError("Negative target")
        scores = round_scores[i]
        # active forced indices in order

        history.append(selected_indices)
        active = set(selected_indices)
    retained_indices = history[-1]
